name_assessment.note: Natural as an informal sports-slang brand: “know” ball signals football knowledge. Keep title case; do not add “the” or “his”.

audience: Vietnamese-speaking football followers who want a clear, memorable explanation of what happened and why it matters.
brand_promise: Mỗi video đưa ra một góc nhìn bóng đá rõ ràng, có lý do và có bằng chứng.
tagline: Bóng đá, nhìn thêm một nhịp.
host_pov: First person, recognizably Allen. Speak as a fan who can explain the game, not as a broadcaster or club spokesperson.

voice_rules.default_register: Conversational Vietnamese; use “mình” for the host and address viewers naturally.
voice_rules.jargon: Explain a necessary tactical term in Vietnamese the first time it appears. Keep widely used names such as pressing only when they make the idea clearer.
voice_rules.humor: One dry or playful line at most; never let a joke replace the explanation.
voice_rules.claims: Separate observable fact from interpretation. Attribute statistics, quotes, and disputed claims.
